title: fix(console): drop the two optimizeDeps.include entries the dev server cannot resolve (objectui#10865)
body:
Fixes #10865
Clause-②: no — a private app's dev-server config (`@object-ui/console`) and a repo test; no published contract, accept set or public surface
Supersedes PR objectui#10936 (same tree; its commits carried a model-named trailer).

## What was wrong

`pnpm dev` in `apps/console` exited 1 before it listened:

```text
error when starting dev server:
[Error: "." is not exported under the conditions ["module", "browser", "development", "import"] from package .../apps/console/node_modules/react-map-gl (see exports field in .../react-map-gl/package.json) ...] {
  code: 'PLUGIN_ERROR', plugin: 'builtin:vite-resolve', hook: 'resolveId'
}
```

`OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` listed the bare `react-map-gl`, and the installed react-map-gl 8.1.2 exports only `./mapbox`, `./maplibre` and `./mapbox-legacy`. Vite resolves every include entry from the dev root before the server listens. When the package is found but has no such subpath, the resolver throws.

Why it broke now: objectui#10749 (merged 2026-09-27) added `react-map-gl` to the console's devDependencies. Before that PR, neither map package was reachable from `apps/console`, so Vite skipped both map entries with a warning. That reading comes from that PR's diff; it was not re-measured on the old tree.

## Change

- `apps/console/vite.config.ts`: `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` drops the bare `'react-map-gl'` and `'maplibre-gl'`. The comment above the list now says how Vite reads it and names the pin. Only this region changes; objectui#10921 and objectui#10901 edit other regions of the same file.
- `scripts/__tests__/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts`: adds the pin described below. The three existing places that pin the list's exact contents now match the new list.

## H2 verdict: `maplibre-gl` was the same class, non-fatal, and dead

`maplibre-gl` is a dependency of `@object-ui/plugin-map` but not of `@object-ui/console`. From the dev root, Vite's include resolver finds nothing for it and logs `Failed to resolve dependency: maplibre-gl, present in client 'optimizeDeps.include'`. That is the same class as the bare `react-map-gl` (an entry the dev server cannot resolve from its root). The outcome differs: this entry is skipped, where `react-map-gl` threw.

Measured on `733fd5ac6` with a temporary wrapper config (never committed): two dev starts, each on a fresh cache.

| run | start | warning | optimized deps |
|---|---|---|---|
| drop bare `react-map-gl` only | listens | `Failed to resolve dependency: maplibre-gl` | 194 |
| drop both | listens | none | 194 |

The two runs' `_metadata.json` files match on the optimized set, the optimized-file map, and the chunk names including hashes. In both runs, maplibre's code sits in the same `maplibre-gl-B0aW9qyJ.js` chunk, carried by the `react-map-gl/maplibre` pre-bundle. In both runs, the `viteMaplibreWorker` dev middleware answered 200 for the worker's sibling URL (`/node_modules/.vite/deps/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs`). So the entry pre-bundled nothing, and dropping it only removes the warning. The alternative, making `maplibre-gl` a console dependency so the entry resolves, would add a dependency to produce a pre-bundle that already exists.

## H3 confirmed

`Build & E2E` concluded `success` on `733fd5ac6`, the commit whose dev start exits 1 (check-runs read: 59 of 59 returned). In Vite 8.2.2, `addManuallyIncludedOptimizeDeps` resolves the include list. Its three callers are the dev optimizer (`createDepsOptimizer`), `vite optimize` and the explicit-environment optimizer. None of them is on the `vite build` path.

## The pin: an existing case extended, no new gate

`vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` already loads the real console config and pins `optimizeDeps.include` byte for byte (the objectui#4854 console-config cases). A new case sits beside them: `resolves each entry from the console root under the dev conditions`. It resolves every entry the way the dev server does:

1. `resolveConfig(consoleConfig, 'serve', 'development')`, with `root` set to `apps/console`.
2. `config.createResolver({ asSrc: false, scan: true })`, called with no importer. This is the resolver Vite 8.2's `createOptimizeDepsIncludeResolver` uses for the client environment.

Each entry gets one of three verdicts:

- **resolved**
- **skipped**: unreachable from the root (the `maplibre-gl` shape)
- **aborts**: the resolver throws (the `react-map-gl` shape)

Any skipped or aborting entry is a finding. Three controls run in the same pass, one per verdict, so a clean result cannot come from a broken instrument:

- `react` must resolve.
- An absent package must read as skipped.
- A subpath that `@objectstack/spec` does not export must read as aborting.

The case refuses nested (`a > b`) and glob entries by name. Vite resolves those by other paths, and this case does not model them.

This PR adds no workflow, script or `check:*` entry. The case runs wherever this file already runs (the `unit` project, `pnpm test`).

## Evidence

**Dev start.** Run in `apps/console`. I recorded the PID of each server I started, killed only that PID, and left nothing on the port.

- `733fd5ac6` (before), with `pnpm exec vite --port 5871 --strictPort`: exit 1, the error above.
- `beaf76316` (after), with `node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --port 5871 --strictPort` (the same binary, run directly so the recorded PID is Vite's own): `VITE v8.2.2 ready` and `GET /` 200. The optimizer finished with no `Failed to resolve dependency` line, the same 194 optimized deps and chunk set as the control above, and a 200 for the maplibre worker URL. `vite.config.ts` is byte-identical at `076c00db4`.

**Ablation.** Predicted: plain red. The new case should report exactly the planted entry, and the two byte-for-byte list pins should fail with it. Each leg ran from the committed `beaf76316` through `ablation-replace.mjs`. That tool requires the anchor to hit and the blob hash to move, and it proves the restore by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **Leg A**, re-plant `'react-map-gl'`: `Tests 3 failed | 39 passed (42)`. The new case's finding was `react-map-gl: aborts the dev server start ("." is not exported under the conditions ["module", "browser", "development", "import"] from package .../react-map-gl ...)`. Restored: blob `cc8f7e84650e` == HEAD.
- **Leg B**, re-plant `'maplibre-gl'`: `Tests 3 failed | 39 passed (42)`. The new case's finding was `maplibre-gl: not reachable from apps/console, so it is skipped with a warning and pre-bundles nothing`. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- The first attempt at leg A was a no-op. The tool refused it because the anchor was contained in the replacement, so the anchor count could not drop. Nothing ran; I changed the anchor and re-ran.

**Local gates**, all at `076c00db4` (the final commit):

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over 16 files: every `scripts/__tests__` file that reads `apps/console/vite.config.ts` (13), the two that use the config-program helpers, and `vite-maplibre-worker.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 16 passed (16)`, `Tests 863 passed (863)`.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts`: exit 0 (`tsc --listFilesOnly` lists the edited test). `pnpm type-check:vitest-config`: exit 0 (`apps/console/tsconfig.node.json` includes `vite.config.ts`).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `no changeset is owed`, because neither file is published source.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- ESLint, narrowed to the two changed files. The narrowing rests on three pieces of evidence:
  1. **Population.** The root `eslint.config.js` is the only flat config (`apps/console` has none), and the JSON report lints both files with no ignore notice.
  2. **Count.** The `--format json` report has 2 entries and 0 errors. `vite.config.ts` has 0 warnings. The test has 5 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the same 5 as the base blob.
  3. **Invariance.** The config has no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no custom rule reads other files, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

NOT MEASURED: full `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, and `Build & E2E` (CI owns them).

## Acceptance notes

- The header of `vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` records an old reverse verification ("`optimizeDeps.include` drops from 7 to 3"). I kept it as a record and added a note that it was measured while the list still had the two removed entries. It was not re-run.
- The map entries were written before the history window reachable here (the deepened graft boundary is `797582fa5`), so when they were added is not measured.
- `react-map-gl/maplibre` stays. I did not measure whether dependency scanning would discover it without the entry. It resolves, and the new case now pins it.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01EBx9rvB7dufCz4at53x35U`. This is a dispatched dev run for seat 2 of domain:devx (objectui#10917).
